methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: proposes the development of a low-cost prototype for monitoring the consumption of electricity in real-time using communication with electronic meters of power distribution companies

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a low-cost monitoring web portal/prototype (PGEN) plus an electronic communication interface; ISO 50001/50006 and energy baselines/indicators are cited only as framing, with no EnPI/EnB measurement model identified or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or baseline construction). Results are raw load curves and simple before/after consumption savings.

paper_type.evidence_quote: O sistema PGEN é desenvolvido em plataforma web, com banco de dados baseado em séries temporais e em linguagens PHP, HTML5, CSS3 e Javascript.

stage1.notes: Data-acquisition/monitoring web portal (PGEN) for public institutions (IFSC campi, government buildings); reports load curves and simple before/after savings but characterises no EnPI/EnB model. Tool/software design, ineligible; application context is buildings/services, not continuous process.
